user.title: Connect to Senseplane
user.description: Paste the access token shown when you added Home Assistant sensors in Senseplane.

data_description.url: The address of your Senseplane API, for example https://senseplane.example.com
data_description.token: Starts with sit_. It only lets Home Assistant send readings to this one sensor.

entities.title: Choose sensors
entities.description: Sensors to send to {name}: temperatures and other numbers, door, window and motion sensors, leaks and smoke, plugs, lights and locks, doorbells and buttons. Every change is sent.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the Senseplane token
reauth_confirm.description: Senseplane refused the token, so readings are paused. Paste the new token for this sensor.

error.invalid_auth: Senseplane refused this token. Check it, or create a new one in Senseplane.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Senseplane at this address.
error.wrong_source: This token belongs to a different Senseplane sensor.

abort.already_configured: This Senseplane sensor is already set up.

init.title: Choose sensors
init.description: Sensors to send to Senseplane: numbers, door, window and motion sensors, leaks and smoke, plugs, lights and locks, doorbells and buttons.
